ev.q: This report summarizes the evidence considered for these updated recommendations, including postlicensure data on vaccine effectiveness and safety
Postlicensure data were reviewed from four observational studies of vaccine effectiveness (VE) of protein subunit RSV vaccination

changes.why: An ACIP recommendation report: every estimate (trial efficacy, observational VE, FDA GBS analysis, VSD signal, benefit-risk model) is cited from other analyses to frame the recommendation, not produced here. The method fields still describe those cited analyses.

ev.q: GBS cases were identified using medical claims data and were not yet confirmed by review of medical records
Results of rapid cycle analysis performed by the Vaccine Safety Datalink §§§ demonstrated a statistical signal for immune thrombocytopenia (ITP)
Age- and risk-stratified annual incidence of RSV-associated outcomes was from analyses using the RSV Hospitalization Surveillance Network (RSV-NET)
Vaccine effectiveness in preventing outcomes was from CDC’s VISION Network during October 1, 2023–March 31, 2024
the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System
A phase 2/3 trial contributed safety and efficacy data from 36,685 immunocompetent participants aged ≥60 years

changes.why: RSV-NET is a population-based hospitalization network like COVID-NET and FluSurv-NET, so it is sentinel/network rather than CDC surveillance system; the other source types stand.

equity.level_reason: Age defines the population and the recommendation strata without social-position framing; rural residence appears only as a recommendation criterion tied to access to escalated care, and equity implications are mentioned in the EtR framework without results.

level_alternative.reason: Rural residence is a clinical-risk eligibility criterion and the EtR equity review is only named, so no SPD is used beyond defining the population.
